newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Durham, N.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Durham, N.C..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 4th Floor, Room 411, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North Carolina 27603-1385, until 11 o'clock A.M., North Carolina Time, such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of $7,190,000 Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1977, of the City of Durham, North Carolina, dated February 1, 1997, and maturing (subject to the right of prior redemption) annually, February 1, $325,000 1998 to 2013, inclusive, $700,000 2014 and 2015, and $590,000 2016. Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919-733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form. The bonds will be delivered on or about February 18, 1997.
